mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the two-way binding picture and explanation connected haemoglobin to oxygen release in working tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding white cells and platelets felt less informative because their roles were not explained.

surprise.text: The developing red cells matured into discs without nuclei as haemoglobin was assembled; the change made me curious about maturation.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, although the reason for adding white cells and platelets was clearer as assembling blood than as understanding their functions.

continue.text: I would continue to see how circulation brings oxygen to the arm's working cells. This chapter establishes the carrier but leaves that connection for later.
